answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 7622 Country: India Title: Question NO.1: What tasbeeh we have to recite after every 4 rakats of taraveeh prayers. Question NO.2: I belong to hanafi madhab. pl. inform me what is the fitra for me. Question: Question NO.1: What tasbeeh we have to recite after every 4 rakats of taraveeh prayers. Question NO.2: I belong to hanafi madhab. pl. inform me what is the fitra for me. Answer ID: 7622 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 895/895=M/1429) After every tarwiha (four rakÂ’ah) of tarawih , one should either recite tasbih , nafl salah or recite the Quran or sit idly: سبحان ذی الملک والملکوت، سبحان ذی العزۃ والعظمۃ القدرۃ والکبریاء والجبروت، سبحان الملک الحی الذی لایموت، سبوح قدوس رب الملائکۃ والروح، لا الہ الا اللہ، نستغفر اللہ، نسالک الجنۃ و نعوذبک من النار ( الشامی ) (2) The fitra ( صدقۃ الفطر ) of a person is: 1.575 kg of wheat or its price. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
